name: Four Seasons Las Vegas
insider_take: Vegas luxury without the chaos - this non-gaming oasis sits right on the Strip but feels worlds away from the madness.
whats_special: Four Seasons Las Vegas occupies floors 35-39 of the Mandalay Bay tower, making it the only non-gaming, non-smoking hotel directly on the Strip. The property features a private entrance, dedicated elevators, and stunning floor-to-ceiling windows offering panoramic desert and mountain views from every room.
pro_tip: Book a west-facing room for incredible sunset views over Red Rock Canyon, or choose east-facing to watch the sunrise illuminate the desert mountains - both are equally spectacular.
dont_miss: The hotel's poolside cabanas offer Strip views while maintaining serenity, and Charlie Palmer Steak serves some of Vegas's finest dining with floor-to-ceiling wine displays. Plus, you can access all Mandalay Bay amenities while retreating to your peaceful Four Seasons sanctuary.
pros: Non-gaming luxury oasis within Mandalay Bay complex
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Panoramic Strip and mountain views from upper floors
Private pool deck exclusive to Four Seasons guests
cons: Premium pricing for Las Vegas market
Must walk through Mandalay Bay casino to access Strip
